stem: Meena's class is listing natural resources for their science project. Which one of the following should she include because it is provided by nature and helps meet our needs?

options.text: a plastic water bottle bought from the market
wind that turns a windmill to make electricity
a wooden chair made by a carpenter
a solar cooker built by her father

teacher.key_rationale: Wind comes directly from nature and helps meet human needs (electricity), so it is a natural resource. The bottle, chair and cooker are human-made items (even if made from natural materials), so they do not qualify.
